claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Iocetamic acid is an iodinated oral cholecystographic contrast agent with no known cytotoxic target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any rare effects being idiosyncratic immune-mediated reactions (thrombocytopenia, skin reactions) rather than direct cytotoxicity.
